instruction: Place a bold 'Annual Summary' title on the initial slide.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding title 'Annual Summary' with bold formatting to the first slide. Evaluator checks if the text exists with bold formatting. Custom getter extracts all text and font properties from the first slide, and custom metric verifies the text exists with bold formatting applied.
